name: metro-map
title_zh: 轨道图式画架构，站点色线分区图例一图齐
tagline_zh: 画架构图总被吐槽像蜘蛛网？把模块当站点、依赖当轨道，色线分区图例全自动排好，还能导出 SVG 深色浅色两版。
tagline_en: Tired of messy architecture diagrams? Draw modules as stations, deps as colored lines, zones & legend.
desc_en: Draw transit-map style diagrams — stations on a grid, coloured lines routed through them, zones banding groups of stations, a legend naming the lines and short notes riding the track between two stops — and render them to a standalone light/dark SVG. Two modes: a metro map on an abstract grid, or a roadmap whose x axis is a dated Gantt-style calendar. Use for landscape, migration, architecture, pi
why_zh: 把抽象关系硬塞进地铁图语法：站点网格、线路配色、区域分带、图例命名全按制图规范来。
why_en: Forces abstract relations into metro-map grammar: grid stations, colored routes, zone bands, legend, and track-side notes—all.
limit_zh: 只认两种模式：抽象网格地铁图，或 x 轴为日期的甘特式路线图。不画环线、不画曲线轨道，站点必须落在网格上。
limit_en: Two modes only: abstract-grid metro or Gantt-style roadmap. No loops, no curved tracks—stations must snap to grid. Outputs SVG only, no PNG/PDF.
